description: The Four Pillars of Destiny (BaZi, 八字 / 四柱): year, month, day and hour pillars, the Day Master (日主) and the five-phase count, from a birth date, time and place, using the exact Start of Spring and solar months. Covers questions like 'what is my BaZi', 'my four pillars', 'my day master', '我的八字'. Facts only, no readings.

birth_city.description: Optional. City of birth, e.g. 'Taipei' or 'Paris, France'.

birth_timezone.description: Optional. IANA timezone of the birth place, if no city.

name: get_four_pillars
title: Four Pillars (BaZi) for a birth
